title: Let the Heads Talk: Beyond Diagonal Graph Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.01494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sheaf Neural Networks generalize scalar-weighted message passing by replacing scalar edge weights with linear transport maps between local feature spaces. Yet the role of this matrix-valued transport is entangled with the broader sheaf-diffusion construction. We isolate the transport primitive through quiver representations and establish a direct connection with multi-head attention. Treating attention heads as coordinates of a local transport space reveals that standard multi-head attention implements diagonal edge maps: along each directed interaction, a source head can contribute only to the corresponding receiver head. Allowing off-diagonal entries instead enables edge-conditioned communication across heads before neighborhood aggregation. We show that this operation cannot, in general, be absorbed into a single shared linear map applied after aggregation. Building on this characterization, we introduce Topological Attention (Top-A),

translated_title: 让注意力头对话：超越对角图注意力
translated_abstract: 层束神经网络通过用局部特征空间之间的线性传输映射取代标量边权重，推广了基于标量权重的消息传递。然而，这种矩阵值传输的作用与更广泛的层束扩散构造纠缠在一起。我们通过箭图表示分离出传输这一基本原语，并建立了其与多头注意力的直接联系。将注意力头视为局部传输空间的坐标可以揭示，标准多头注意力实现的其实是对角边映射：在每条有向交互中，源注意力头只能贡献给对应的接收注意力头。而允许非对角元素的存在，则能够在邻域聚合之前实现以边为条件的跨头通信。我们证明，这种操作通常无法被吸收为聚合之后施加的单个共享线性映射。基于这一刻画，我们引入了拓扑注意力，
tldr: 本文通过箭图表示将层束神经网络的线性传输与多头注意力建立直接联系，揭示标准多头注意力只能实现对角边映射，并提出拓扑注意力（Top-A）以支持邻域聚合前基于边的跨头非对角通信，且证明该操作无法被聚合后的共享线性映射所替代。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a direct link between sheaf neural networks' linear transport and multi-head attention via quiver representations, reveals that standard attention implements only diagonal edge maps, and introduces Topological Attention (Top-A) enabling edge-conditioned off-diagonal cross-head communication before aggregation, which provably cannot be absorbed into a shared post-aggregation linear map.
